variant_mode_subtitle_shared: Saved as flavours of one product — stock is shared
variant_mode_subtitle_separate: Each one saved as its own product — stock per colour
variant_mode_choose_title: How should colours and flavours be saved?
variant_mode_choose_intro: Some items come in several colours or flavours, like a hair cream in five colours. Choose how the shop records them.
variant_mode_shared_pros: Quick to enter: one product, one price and a code per colour, without repeating the item's details.
variant_mode_shared_cons: Stock is counted for the whole item. The app can't tell how many of each colour were sold or are left, and the low-stock warning covers all colours together.
variant_mode_separate_pros: Each colour has its own stock, its own low-stock warning and its own lines in the reports, so you know exactly what sold and what is left.
variant_mode_separate_cons: The catalogue gets longer, and a price change has to be made on each colour.

coffee_menu_intro: Publishing copies your catalogue to your Google account so the Coffee Menu web app, signed in with the same account, can import it. Nothing is sent until you press Publish.
coffee_menu_shared_body: Product and category names, retail and wholesale prices, barcodes, an in-stock flag, and product photos only if you turn them on.

coffee_menu_include_photos_desc: Upload compressed product photos (uses your free cloud storage)
coffee_menu_include_photos_info: Photos are resized to at most 1024 pixels and only changed photos are uploaded again. Turning this off deletes the published photos.

coffee_menu_auto_publish_info: Off by default to protect your free cloud quota. Nothing is uploaded when the catalogue has not changed.
